import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
C=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_comparison.csv'); P=pd.read_csv('fsh3_surface_patch.csv'); T=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_conservation.csv')
known=C[C['substrate_heavy_atoms'].notna()].copy()
k2=known[known['pocket_vol_A3'].notna()]
rho,p=spearmanr(k2['substrate_heavy_atoms'],k2['pocket_vol_A3'])
rho2,p2=spearmanr(k2['substrate_heavy_atoms'],k2['tunnel_A'])
print('vol rho %.2f p %.2f (n=%d); tunnel rho %.2f p %.2f'%(rho,p,len(k2),rho2,p2))
fs=C[C['structure'].str.startswith('FSH3')].iloc[0]
print('FSH3 vol %.0f tunnel %.1f lining %d arom %d basic %d'%(fs.pocket_vol_A3,fs.tunnel_A,fs.n_lining,fs.n_arom_lining,fs.n_basic_lining))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(k2['substrate_heavy_atoms'],k2['pocket_vol_A3'],s=80,color='#2b6cb0',zorder=3)
for r in k2.itertuples():
    ax.annotate(r.structure.split()[0],(r.substrate_heavy_atoms,r.pocket_vol_A3),fontsize=8,xytext=(5,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax.scatter([55],[0],s=80,marker='x',color='#718096',zorder=3)
ax.annotate('TLL (no cavity detected,\nlid closed)',(55,0),fontsize=8,xytext=(-78,10),textcoords='offset points',color='#718096')
ax.axhline(fs.pocket_vol_A3,color='#c53030',ls='--',lw=1.3)
ax.text(14,fs.pocket_vol_A3+70,'FSH3 model = %.0f A$^3$'%fs.pocket_vol_A3,color='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('substrate heavy atoms (known physiological substrate)')
ax.set_ylabel('cavity volume at the nucleophile (A$^3$)')
ax.set_title('Pocket volume does not track substrate size\nSpearman rho = %.2f, p = %.2f, n = %d'%(rho,p,len(k2)),fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
Q=P.sort_values('patch_near_site')
ax.barh(Q['structure'],Q['patch_near_site'],color=['#c53030' if s.startswith('FSH3') else ('#2f855a' if s.startswith('LPLA2') else '#a0aec0') for s in Q['structure']])
ax.set_xlabel('exposed apolar patch within 18 A of Ser OG (A$^2$)')
ax.set_title('Interfacial proxy does not separate the classes either\nLPLA2, a certain diacyl-PC hydrolase, ranks 9th of 10',fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax=axes[2]
cat={12,15,116,117,118,153,180,183,209}; head={59,61,154,82,187}
T['grp']=['catalytic / nucleophile elbow' if r.pos in cat else ('candidate headgroup basic' if r.pos in head else 'other pocket lining') for r in T.itertuples()]
for g,c in [('catalytic / nucleophile elbow','#2f855a'),('candidate headgroup basic','#c53030'),('other pocket lining','#a0aec0')]:
    s=T[T['grp']==g]; ax.scatter(s['identity'],s['class_conserv'],s=80,color=c,label=g,edgecolor='k',linewidth=0.4,zorder=3)
for r in T.itertuples():
    if r.pos in head or r.pos in {117,180,209}:
        ax.annotate('%s%d'%(r.FSH3,r.pos),(r.identity,r.class_conserv),fontsize=8,xytext=(5,-4),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlabel('identity conservation, 65 fungal orthologs'); ax.set_ylabel('residue-class conservation')
ax.set_xlim(-0.05,1.08); ax.set_ylim(-0.05,1.08)
ax.set_title('What is conserved in the pocket is the catalytic machinery,\nnot a cationic headgroup site',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(sorted(os.listdir('.')))
